detailed_descriptions.en: In the world of “One Way Tickets” , you play as the driver of a vehicle, setting out on a wondrous journey together with the companions you meet along the way. Your little car races along the roads of a fantasy world—enjoying the scenery while facing enemies that appear along the route. Use the control panel to operate your equipped devices, repel enemies, and gather resources. Can't keep up? Call on the companions you meet along the way to help! By interacting with the vehicle control panel below, you can direct the actions of the car shown above. As the stages progress, you may find yourself increasingly overwhelmed—but don't worry. We've provided all kinds of upgrades and helpers for your journey to make driving and operating devices easier. During the journey, you can drive your vehicle to crush and ram enemies, or operate devices to launch various attacks. But always keep an eye on your remaining energy, as well as the challenges brought by enemies and weather. One wrong move could undo everything—but don't be discouraged. You can bring back some materials to upgrade your abilities, and next time you'll surely go farther! Along the way, players can take a rest in safe zones (both in-game and out). Various merchants here sell items that make your journey more interesting. There may also be some unexpected events...? In any case, it's all part of the journey. Build your own vehicle however you like! After the journey ends, you'll return to the main camp with your materials. Upgrade various abilities and buildings at the camp, and grow stronger step by step! Different upgrade choices will affect your future journeys, so choose carefully! We've prepared four world biomes for this EA version, each containing 3 sub-scenes with distinct atmospheres, and each world has its own unique monsters and weather systems. There are also all kinds of collection systems—Device, Characters, Monsters, Relics, and Loots waiting for you to collect! *The game will launch in Early Access. We'll bring more features, worlds, equipment, builds, and more in future updates. Stay tuned! *At launch, only Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English will be available. We'll closely monitor wishlist data and prioritize translating the most anticipated languages. So remember to add our game to your wishlist! *Bug Report & Feedback:

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
In the world of “One Way Tickets” , you play as the driver of a vehicle, setting out on a wondrous journey together with the companions you meet along the way. Your little car races along the roads of a fantasy world—enjoying the scenery while facing enemies that appear along the route. Use the control panel to operate your equipped devices, repel enemies, and gather resources. Can't keep up? Call on the companions you meet along the way to help!

By interacting with the vehicle control panel below, you can direct the actions of the car shown above. As the stages progress, you may find yourself increasingly overwhelmed—but don't worry. We've provided all kinds of upgrades and helpers for your journey to make driving and operating devices easier.

During the journey, you can drive your vehicle to crush and ram enemies, or operate devices to launch various attacks. But always keep an eye on your remaining energy, as well as the challenges brought by enemies and weather. One wrong move could undo everything—but don't be discouraged. You can bring back some materials to upgrade your abilities, and next time you'll surely go farther!

Along the way, players can take a rest in safe zones (both in-game and out). Various merchants here sell items that make your journey more interesting. There may also be some unexpected events...? In any case, it's all part of the journey. Build your own vehicle however you like!

After the journey ends, you'll return to the main camp with your materials. Upgrade various abilities and buildings at the camp, and grow stronger step by step! Different upgrade choices will affect your future journeys, so choose carefully!

We've prepared four world biomes for this EA version, each containing 3 sub-scenes with distinct atmospheres, and each world has its own unique monsters and weather systems. There are also all kinds of collection systems—Device, Characters, Monsters, Relics, and Loots waiting for you to collect!

*The game will launch in Early Access. We'll bring more features, worlds, equipment, builds, and more in future updates. Stay tuned!

*At launch, only Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English will be available. We'll closely monitor wishlist data and prioritize translating the most anticipated languages. So remember to add our game to your wishlist!
